absent-from-2014.flag: its whole text is not in the 2014 transcription
absent-from-2014.answer: 2014 line 15002 has the same rule with a '## Page 374' marker before d): page break only. Re-read §2002:13.16.36.3 GR6 (FORMAT 1): it governs only a screen item's occurrences; unchanged.

communication-reach.flag: clause 13.16.36 is reached by the 2002 communication section (Annex A, the CD entry)
communication-reach.answer: No reach: GR6 applies only 'If the description of a screen item includes the OCCURS clause'; a CD record entry is a data description entry, never a screen description entry, so a format 1 OCCURS under a CD is outside this rule (it is governed by the other format 1 rules). Scope stays the screen section, licensed and declined at 2002.
